overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics, specifically marital complexities and husband-wife emotional realities, significantly outperform generic poetry, sad shayari, or isolated family member tributes in this sample size.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) generated 5-10x more views than other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on complex, grounded romantic and marital relationship realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable dilemma or questioning everyday relationship habits ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') garner higher baseline engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, thought-provoking statements rather than heavy sad poetry.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on abstract pain like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' underperformed dramatically with only 15 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic or abstract shayari; anchor content in tangible daily life observations.
